Please find the attached Contract Modification #1 to Professional Services Agreement #7606
between the City and WEST Inc.for environmental services on the Dry Creek Dredging and
Maintenance Project.This modification to the existing agreement will provide additional
environmental services focusing onthe permitting requirements aswell as environmental surveys
for futures project areas.This modification will provide the needed environmental services to
assist the City coordinate with all governmental agencies to maintain our drainage systems.
Engineering Staff evaluates fee proposals for engineering services based on time and material
estimates for the specific project.Those costs are readily tracked and verified during design
operations and the City only pays for the actual time expended.We believe this agreement will
provide the required services to complete this project.
The fees include services focusing on the permitting and environmental surveys.Fundingfor this
project will come from the 2019 - 2022 1% Specific Purpose Tax Fund (5th Penny).The total
professional services will be a cost not-to-exceed $72,988.00.We respectfully request your
approval of this professional services agreement.
